module: Node "Race Complete" (repeat_instant, tag input). Output pins: complete (flow when the race is finished) and ongoing (flow as long as it is not). Switches to finished on the onScenarioFinished hook.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

onScenarioFinished.desc: Scenario end hook: marks the race as finished.
